title: Blob Royale protocol v3 welcome data
description: Everything a session learns about itself, sent exactly once immediately after the upgrade and before any snapshot. accepted_command_kinds is an advertisement of what the boundary will accept from this client, not a grant: the server enforces the same set independently and InputBatch::create filters it a second time. npc_controller_kinds is the same kind of advertisement for the one closed vocabulary a client is allowed to name a value from.

terrain.$comment: Required complete immutable authored terrain. Never repeated in snapshot frames.

entity_id.$comment: The session's FIRST body only. An eliminated or match-reset body is destroyed and the server seats the same controller_id on a new entity_id, so a client that caches this value renders the wrong blob after one match. Resolve the own body by controller_id.

controller_id.$comment: Durable for the whole connection and the only stable self-identifier. A reconnect is a new join and receives a new controller_id.

accepted_command_kinds.$comment: maxItems tracks the eight client-sendable kinds in common.schema.json. The published set is the intersection of the mode's accepted kinds with that vocabulary, never a server-issued kind such as spawn or despawn. Sandbox publishes set_thrust, shield and charge.

npc_controller_kinds.$comment: The unprofiled selectable partition of the immutable NPC catalogue, in declared order. Empty is legal. A kind MUST NOT appear here and in npc_profiles; both partitions come from the same validated server value. The unchanged limit is independent of the current registered bot count.

npc_profiles.$comment: Profiled selectable partition of the same NPC catalogue, omitted when empty. Each exact kind/profile pair is unique and its kind is absent from npc_controller_kinds. Numeric personality settings remain configuration, not a second mutable client authority.

lobby_id.$comment: The room this session was admitted into, named by the canonical /api/v3/lobbies/<lobby_id>/session path. There is no room-one alias.

seat_count_maximum.$comment: The most seats this room's map can seat -- its spawn-marker count capped at the seat bound -- so a client can floor its seat-count control without a second round trip. A set_seat_count above it is ignored by the tick. Added in 2.4.
